cells.name: breath_hex
cells.species: hex dots breathing on a rounded square wave that lags outward
eq: dot radius = s·(0.1…0.47 by w),  hex grid

cells.name: ripple_hex
cells.species: a damped radial sine ripple sets dot radius and glow
eq: dot radius = ½s·(0.12…0.98 by a),  hex grid

cells.name: cross_waves
cells.species: two crossing plane waves swell rounded-square dots
eq: d̂₁ at angle α = 0.1…1.2 + 0.1 sin 0.3t,  d̂₂ at α + 2.1
f = 10…28,  square dot half-size = ½s·(0.12…0.96 by w)

cells.name: standing_nodes
cells.species: a two-mode standing wave: nodes vanish, sign sets tone
eq: a = sin mπx·sin nπy·cos ωt + b·sin nπx·sin mπy·sin ωt

cells.name: dot_lens
cells.species: a drifting magnifier: the hex grid swells under its focus

cells.name: parabola_band
cells.species: square pixels lit by distance to a shimmering parabola

cells.name: horizon_arc
cells.species: a planet limb with pulses leaving it on a clock

cells.name: sine_band
cells.species: a scrolling two-harmonic sine band with a breathing width
eq: f(x) = A sin X + 0.45A sin(2.7X − 1.3vt),  X = 8x + vt

cells.name: nested_arches
cells.species: nested parabolic arches with brightness rolling outward
eq: y′ = y + 0.45 + a·x²,  arch i = round(y′/Δ),  i = 1…9

cells.name: lissajous_trace
cells.species: a Lissajous comet traced into a pixel grid with a fading tail

cells.name: trace_grid
cells.species: hashed trace segments light, hold and decay on a grid

cells.name: lattice_sparks
cells.species: sparks random-walk triangular lattice edges and leave trails

cells.name: sweep_front
cells.species: two sweep fronts cross a node grid and leave afterglow

cells.name: bus_lines
cells.species: a PCB bus with 45 degree jogs carries data packets

cells.name: truchet_flow
cells.species: Truchet quarter arcs carry a flowing current on fine dots

cells.name: sonar_rings
cells.species: sonar rings born on a clock from a source below the frame

cells.name: raindrops
cells.species: raindrop rings on dot bands that step up a density ramp

cells.name: ring_interference
cells.species: two ring sources interfere, a moire of bright and null dots
eq: a = ½·(cos(k|x − s₁| − ωt) + cos(k|x − s₂| − ωt))

cells.name: drop_pond
cells.species: a pond of drops: dots shift and shade with the ring slope
eq: a = fract((0.2…0.55)·t + hash),  one drop per cell of 0.6…0.35

cells.name: warp_halftone
cells.species: a 45 degree AM screen over domain-warped fbm
eq: q = fbm₂(2.2x),  r = fbm₂(2.2x + 3q),  F = ½ + 0.8·fbm(2.2x + 3r)
AM screen at 0.35…1.22 rad:  dot radius = 0.707·s·√v

cells.name: cmy_rosette
cells.species: three screens at 15, 75 and 0 degrees form a CMY rosette (own inks)
eq: F = swirl(x, t),  θ′ = θ + twist/(r + 0.25) − 0.6t
dot radius = 0.62·s·√F,  color = paper·Π (1 − cov·(1 − ink))

cells.name: band_halftone
cells.species: folded noise bands on a 30 degree screen, light on dark

cells.name: swirl_halftone
cells.species: a vortex on a turning screen; dots swell where it runs hot
eq: screen turns at (0…0.25)·t,  dot radius = s·(0.55…0.78)·√F + 0.05s

cells.name: flame_halftone
cells.species: a rising flame ramp in tall elliptical dots

cells.name: line_screen
cells.species: a wavy line screen whose line weight follows the warp

cells.name: bayer4_plasma
cells.species: 4x4 Bayer thresholds on a sine plasma, N tone levels

cells.name: bayer8_orbs
cells.species: 8x8 Bayer on shaded orbs that orbit and merge

cells.name: ign_clouds
cells.species: interleaved gradient noise thresholds on drifting fbm clouds

cells.name: diffusion_look
cells.species: a lit sphere through high-passed white noise, an error-diffusion look

cells.name: two_vs_seven
cells.species: a drifting border splits a two-tone and a seven-tone Bayer region

cells.name: clustered_dot
cells.species: a 4x4 clustered-dot ordered dither on a rotating gradient

cells.name: noise_matrix
cells.species: an LED panel stepping through PWM levels of drifting noise

cells.name: marquee
cells.species: three LED marquees of 5x7 glyphs from u32 bitmaps

cells.name: spectrum_bars
cells.species: a spectrum analyser of LED bars with falling peak holds

cells.name: led_clock
cells.species: an LED clock counts mm:ss from the hover clock

cells.name: scope_trace
cells.species: a heartbeat trace sweeps an LED scope with phosphor persistence
